rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for physical ear pain, and it can also describe irritation from excessively loud noise.

example.english: I had an earache after swimming last night.
example.traditional: 我噚晚游水之後有耳仔痛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 jau4 seoi2 zi1 hau6 jau5 ji5 zai2 tung3

rows.note: Use this for a bout of nagging, complaining, or scolding, rather than for literal ear pain.

example.english: Last night Mom gave me an earache because I came home late.
example.traditional: 尋晚阿媽因為我夜返，畀咗我一餐鬧。
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 aa3 maa1 jan1 wai6 ngo5 je6 faan1 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 caan1 naau6
